description: This source file implements methods for the CalculatorButtonPressedEventArgs class, handling command parameters to extract operation types and auditory feedback information within a calculator application's view model.

classes.name: CalculatorButtonPressedEventArgs
classes.description: A class representing event arguments for calculator button press events, providing methods to retrieve operation types and auditory feedback based on command parameters.

methods.name: GetOperationFromCommandParameter
methods.description: Extracts the operation enum from a command parameter, casting it to CalculatorButtonPressedEventArgs if possible, or directly to NumbersAndOperatorsEnum otherwise.

methods.name: GetAuditoryFeedbackFromCommandParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the auditory feedback string from a command parameter if it is of type CalculatorButtonPressedEventArgs; returns null otherwise.
